title: Rabindranath Tagore
text:
Our Mission
The objectives of the Prairie Tagore Society are to:
Organize and promote social, cultural and intellectual events which celebrate diversity, inter-cultural harmony and universalism, and raise awareness of Eastern philosophies and cultures, with special emphasis on and guided by Rabindranath Tagore’s universal humanism, transcendental spirituality, thoughts and philosophy as expressed through his poems, songs, writings, plays, lectures, art, social reforms and other works.

title: Praire Tagore Society
text:
Prairie Tagore Society Inc. is a registered non-profit organization dedicated to promoting primarily Bengali culture through music, literature, arts, and community events.
Our goal is to build cultural bridges, enhance multicultural harmony, and celebrate the artistic legacy of Bengali culture within the Canadian social landscape.
We aim to spread the richness of the sub-continental modern and classical songs, dances, poetry as well as other forms of art by embracing and including the cultural mosaic of Canada.
